capabilities: Infer note titles from frontmatter properties, first H1 heading, or filename
Rewrite display text of wikilinks and Markdown links across the vault
Preserve custom link text via an ignore directive or note property
Auto-update link text on save and rename, with debounce and similarity settings
Run commands to update links for the current file or all links in the vault
extras: README warns the plugin can modify many files when backlinked notes change and recommends backing up the vault before use.
problem: Obsidian links display filenames, which stay stale or meaningless when a note's real title differs from its filename.

relations.evidence: Front Matter Title: Consistent title display

summary: Link text updater that rewrites wikilink and Markdown link display text to note titles inferred from frontmatter, first heading, or filename.
